constraints: An element must already be open (via SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT) before this command is called, otherwise an error is generated.
If data evaluates to undefined, 4D substitutes an empty string.

By default, special characters (< > ” ’...) in data are encoded, unless encoding was disabled for the current process via XML SET OPTIONS (XML string encoding = XML raw data); passing the optional * parameter forces encoding of special characters even when that raw-data mode is active.
To insert pre-encoded binary content, base64-encode it yourself with BASE64 ENCODE and pass the resulting BLOB in data.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): SAX write document lifecycle: SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT (or the ARRAYS variant) opens an element -> SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE adds its content while it remains open -> SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT closes the most recently opened element (or the document itself is closed, which auto-closes any still-open elements).
